ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis represents spatial belts, from left to right respectively the urban area, near suburbs, and far suburbs; the vertical axis represents industrial density. The legend shows that the solid line represents manufacturing industry, and the dashed line represents service industry. Only observe the two solid lines of manufacturing industry: the high-value position of the manufacturing industry solid line in 1995 is relatively close to the boundary area between the urban area and the near suburbs; the highest point of the manufacturing industry solid line in 2009 is more obviously located in the near suburbs. Then reason: the peak position of the industrial density curve can represent the main agglomeration area of that industry. Compared with 1995, the peak value of manufacturing industry density in 2009 turned more prominently toward the near suburbs, indicating that the manufacturing industry agglomerated toward the near suburbs.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：确认横轴空间带、市区—近郊区—远郊区，纵轴为产业密度，并根据图例只看代表制造业的实线。再比较1995年和2009年两条制造业实线的最高点位置：2009年的制造业密度高值区位于近郊区，较1995年更明显地在近郊形成峰值。由峰值代表集聚中心，得出制造业向近郊区集聚。
